places.name: Frederic Leighton's Birthplace
places.connection: Frederic Leighton, a key figure in the Aesthetic Movement, was born in Scarborough.

places.name: Leighton House Museum
places.connection: Leighton House Museum was the home of Frederic Leighton, a prominent artist associated with the Aesthetic Movement.

places.name: Chelsea
places.connection: Chelsea was a hub for artists and intellectuals involved in the Aesthetic Movement during the late 19th century.

places.name: Victoria and Albert Museum
places.connection: The Victoria and Albert Museum holds a significant collection of artworks and artifacts related to the Aesthetic Movement.

places.name: The Grosvenor Gallery
places.connection: The Grosvenor Gallery was an important venue for exhibiting works of the Aesthetic Movement.
